name: bnc-port
description: A BNC socket with two bayonet studs and a hollow center.
useCase: Identify a BNC connection on audio, video, test or radio equipment.
misuse: Pair this icon with a visible label when identifying a connection.

16.reason: Two connected bayonet studs extend vertically from a circular shell. The central socket keeps a 2px opening.

24.reason: Concentric circles retain a hollow socket while opposed studs define the bayonet fitting. More than 2px separates the two rings.
